lines: About Us — Lunaavo
Welcome to Lunaavo — Making Everyday Living Better
At Lunaavo, we believe a well-equipped kitchen can make everyday life easier, more enjoyable, and more inspiring.

Whether you're preparing your morning coffee, cooking a family dinner, upgrading your kitchen appliances, or exploring new ways to prepare your favorite meals, having the right equipment makes a difference.
That's why Lunaavo is dedicated to bringing together a wide selection of kitchen and dining essentials in one convenient online shopping destination.
From everyday cooking appliances to specialized kitchen equipment, our goal is simple: help you find practical products that fit your home, your lifestyle, and your needs.
Visit us at https://lunaavo.us.
Who We Are
Lunaavo is a U.S.-based online retail store operated by San Rafael Luggage Center, Inc, with its business address in Berkeley, California.
We focus on kitchen and dining products designed for a variety of household needs, cooking preferences, and lifestyles.

We understand that choosing kitchen equipment is about more than selecting a product. It's about finding something that fits your space, suits your cooking habits, and provides the functionality you're looking for.
Our online store is organized to make exploring different products and comparing options more convenient.
Whether you're shopping for an essential appliance or a specialized cooking tool, Lunaavo aims to make the experience straightforward and informative.
What You'll Find at Lunaavo
Our Kitchen & Dining collection brings together products for everyday food preparation, cooking, beverage making, and kitchen organization.
Coffee & Beverage Essentials
Start your day with equipment suited to your favorite drinks.
Explore options for preparing coffee, espresso, tea, and other beverages, with different features and capacities to suit individual preferences.
Cooking & Food Preparation
From preparing ingredients to cooking complete meals, the right kitchen equipment can simplify everyday tasks.
Our product selection includes cooking and food preparation appliances for a range of needs, from routine meals to more specialized recipes.
Kitchen Appliances
Explore kitchen equipment designed for different cooking spaces and household requirements.
We aim to make product specifications and available options easy to review, helping you choose equipment that suits your kitchen.
Specialized Kitchen Equipment
For customers who enjoy experimenting with recipes or preparing particular foods, Lunaavo also offers a selection of specialized kitchen products.
Whether you're exploring new cooking techniques or upgrading existing equipment, our store provides a convenient place to compare available choices.
Our Mission
To make shopping for kitchen and dining essentials simpler, more accessible, and more convenient.
We want customers to feel informed and confident as they explore products and make purchasing decisions.
Our mission is guided by four priorities:
Product Variety
Bring together a useful selection of kitchen and dining products to serve different preferences, budgets, and household needs.
Clear Product Information
Present product details, specifications, and available features so customers can make informed comparisons.
Convenient Online Shopping
Provide an organized shopping experience that makes it easier to browse categories, discover products, and complete purchases.
Helpful Customer Support
Make it easy for customers to contact us with questions about products, orders, delivery, returns, and other shopping concerns.
Why Shop With Lunaavo?
1. A Store Focused on Kitchen & Dining
Lunaavo is designed around the products that support everyday cooking and dining.
Rather than requiring customers to search across unrelated departments, we aim to provide a focused shopping destination for kitchen-related essentials.
2. Products for Different Needs
Every kitchen is different.
Some customers need compact appliances for smaller spaces, while others are searching for larger equipment or specialized features.
Our goal is to offer options across different product types and specifications.
3. Information That Helps You Decide
We understand that kitchen appliances can involve important considerations, including dimensions, capacity, power requirements, compatibility, and installation.
We encourage customers to review the available product specifications and contact us whenever additional clarification is needed.
4. Convenient Shopping From Home
Lunaavo allows customers to explore products, compare available options, and place orders online without visiting multiple physical stores.
Our website is designed to make browsing and shopping more straightforward.
5. Customer Support When You Need It
Questions can arise before or after a purchase.
Our support channels are available to help customers with product inquiries, order-related questions, and general assistance.
Email: info@lunaavo.us
Business Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM
Live Chat Support: Available 24/7
Our Commitment to Customers
At Lunaavo, we believe a positive shopping experience begins with clear communication and accessible information.
We aim to provide customers with:
* Clear product descriptions and specifications.
* Transparent pricing and checkout information.
* Accessible shipping and delivery policies.
* Clearly explained return and refund procedures.
* Convenient ways to contact customer support.
* Information about applicable product warranties and support options.
* Respectful handling of customer questions and concerns.
We encourage customers to review the relevant product information and store policies before purchasing.
Our commitment is to make important shopping information easy to find and understand.
Supporting Your Everyday Kitchen Experience
The kitchen is more than a place to prepare meals.
It's where mornings begin, recipes are explored, meals are shared, and everyday routines come together.
Whether you're making a quick breakfast, preparing coffee before work, experimenting with a new recipe, or upgrading an appliance, the equipment you choose plays a part in that experience.
Lunaavo is here to help you explore the products that support those moments.
We believe shopping for kitchen equipment should be practical, informative, and convenient.
A U.S.-Based Business
Lunaavo operates under San Rafael Luggage Center, Inc, with its business address in Berkeley, California.
We believe customers should be able to identify the business operating the store and know how to contact us.
Our Business Information
Store Name: Lunaavo
Legal Business Name: San Rafael Luggage Center, Inc
Business Address:
2221 Shattuck Ave.
Berkeley, CA 94704
United States
Official Website: https://lunaavo.us
Customer Support Email: info@lunaavo.us
Business Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM
Live Chat: Available 24/7

Our listed business address is provided for business identification and correspondence. Please contact customer support before sending returns or visiting the location, as return instructions and in-person services may differ.
We're Here to Help

Whether you're researching your next kitchen appliance, comparing product features, or looking for assistance with an existing order, our customer support team is available through our published contact channels.
You can reach us through:
Email: info@lunaavo.us
Website: https://lunaavo.us
You can also use our website's live chat for assistance.
For questions about shipping, returns, payments, or product support, please refer to our customer care pages.
Discover Lunaavo
Your kitchen deserves equipment that fits the way you live.
From everyday essentials to specialized cooking appliances, Lunaavo brings together kitchen and dining products to help you find what you're looking for.
Explore our collections, compare your options, and discover products for your home.
Lunaavo — Bringing More to Your Kitchen.
Explore Our Kitchen & Dining Collection Today.

lines: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
Welcome to the Lunaavo Help Center
At Lunaavo, we believe shopping for kitchen appliances and dining essentials should be simple, convenient, and reliable.
Whether you're comparing appliances, placing an order, tracking a delivery, or requesting assistance after a purchase, we're here to help.
Below are answers to frequently asked questions about our products, payments, shipping, returns, warranties, and customer support.
Customer Support Email: info@lunaavo.us
Business Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time
Live Chat: Available 24/7
1. General Questions
Q1. What is Lunaavo?
Lunaavo is a U.S.-based online store specializing in kitchen appliances, cooking equipment, and dining essentials.
Our selection includes products designed to make everyday cooking, food preparation, and kitchen activities more convenient.
We focus on offering brand-new products, competitive pricing, transparent shopping policies, and accessible customer support.
Website: https://www.lunaavo.us/
Q2. Is Lunaavo a legitimate U.S. business?
Lunaavo is operated by San Rafael Luggage Center, Inc, with its listed business address in Berkeley, California.
We provide our legal business information, contact details, and customer service policies to help shoppers make informed purchasing decisions.
Legal Business Name: San Rafael Luggage Center, Inc
Business Address: 2221 Shattuck Ave., Berkeley, CA 94704, United States
Customer Support: info@lunaavo.us
If you have questions about our business or an order, our customer support team is available to assist you.
Q3. Where is Lunaavo located?
Our business address is:
Lunaavo — San Rafael Luggage Center, Inc
2221 Shattuck Ave.
Berkeley, CA 94704
United States
Lunaavo operates as an online retail store.
We do not offer in-person shopping, warehouse collection, or customer pickup.
All eligible orders are delivered through our shipping and logistics partners.
Q4. What products does Lunaavo sell?
We specialize in kitchen and dining products, including:
* Coffee makers and espresso machines.
* Ovens and cooktops.
* Food mixers and blenders.
* Food preparation appliances.
* Cooking equipment.
* Kitchen accessories.
* Other kitchen and dining essentials.
Product availability may change as our catalog is updated.
Visit our website to explore the current selection.
Q5. Are all Lunaavo products brand-new?
Yes. All products sold by Lunaavo are brand-new and unused.
Our products are supplied in their original product packaging with the applicable components and accessories specified in their listings.
We do not sell used or refurbished products.
If you have questions about a particular model, its packaging, or included accessories, contact our customer support team before purchasing.
Q6. Why are some Lunaavo products priced lower than other retailers?
We aim to offer competitive pricing through supplier relationships, inventory management, and promotional pricing opportunities.
Product prices can vary between retailers based on purchasing costs, inventory levels, and current promotions.
A lower price does not mean that the product is used or refurbished.
All Lunaavo products are sold as brand-new.
We encourage customers to compare model numbers, specifications, included accessories, and applicable warranty terms when evaluating products.
2. Product Information & Availability
Q7. How do I choose the right appliance for my kitchen?
Before purchasing an appliance, we recommend reviewing:
* Product dimensions.
* Available installation space.
* Capacity and performance specifications.
* Electrical, gas, or plumbing requirements.
* Model number and compatibility.
* Included accessories.
* Manufacturer recommendations.
For larger appliances, confirm that the product will fit your intended location and meet the necessary utility requirements.
If you're unsure which model is suitable, contact our support team with the product link and your requirements.
Q8. Are products listed on Lunaavo available to order?
Products displayed as available on our website can generally be ordered through checkout.
Inventory levels may change due to demand, supplier availability, and ongoing order processing.
If a product becomes unavailable after an order is placed, our team will review the situation and communicate the available options.
For confirmation about a particular product, contact us before placing your order.
Q9. Do appliances come with accessories?
Included accessories depend on the product and manufacturer.
Please review the product description and specifications to determine which accessories are included.
Items shown in promotional or lifestyle photographs may not be included unless specifically stated in the product listing.
If you need clarification, our support team can help you review the available product information.
Q10. Do you sell replacement parts or appliance accessories?
Our catalog may include compatible accessories and replacement parts for selected products.
Availability depends on the specific appliance and our current inventory.
We recommend searching our website or contacting support with the appliance's model number to check for suitable products.
3. Ordering & Checkout
Q11. How do I place an order?
Ordering from Lunaavo is straightforward:
1. Browse our website and select your preferred product.
2. Review the product specifications, price, and availability.
3. Add the product to your shopping cart.
4. Proceed to checkout.
5. Enter your billing and shipping details.
6. Select an available payment method.
7. Review your order information.
8. Complete your purchase.
Once your order is successfully submitted, an order confirmation will be displayed, and you may receive a confirmation email.
Q12. Can I place an order without creating an account?
Yes. Lunaavo supports guest checkout.
You can place an order without registering for a customer account.
Simply enter your required billing, shipping, and contact information during checkout.
We recommend providing a valid email address so you can receive order confirmations, shipping updates, and important communications.
Q13. How do I know whether my order was successful?
After completing checkout, you should see an order confirmation or order status message.
You may also receive an order confirmation email containing your purchase details.
If you do not receive an email:
* Check your spam or junk folder.
* Verify the email address entered during checkout.
* Contact our customer support team.
If you're unsure whether an order was submitted successfully, please contact us before placing another order to avoid duplicate purchases.
Q14. Can I modify my order after placing it?
If you need to change your order, contact us as soon as possible.
We may be able to assist with changes before the order is dispatched.
Once an order has shipped, certain modifications may no longer be possible.
Please email info@lunaavo.us with your order number and the changes you would like to request.
Q15. Can I cancel my order?
Yes. Lunaavo offers free order cancellation before dispatch.
If your order has not yet been dispatched, you may request cancellation without a cancellation fee.
To request cancellation, contact our customer support team as soon as possible with your order number.
Once an order has been dispatched, it can no longer be canceled through the standard pre-dispatch cancellation process.
However, you may still qualify for a return under our 30-day Returns & Refunds Policy after delivery.
Cancellation Fee Before Dispatch: $0
For more information, visit:
https://www.lunaavo.us/cancellation-policy/
4. Payments & Pricing
Q16. What payment methods does Lunaavo accept?
Lunaavo supports credit and debit card payments and Afterpay when available at checkout.
Supported payment options may include major card networks and available financing services.
Because payment provider availability may change, the exact payment methods offered can vary over time.
The payment options displayed on the checkout page are the most accurate and up-to-date methods available for your purchase.
Please review the available payment methods before completing your order.
If a payment option is not displayed, it may not currently be available.
Q17. Is it safe to make payments on Lunaavo?
We aim to provide a secure online shopping experience.
Payments are handled through the payment services integrated with our checkout.
For your protection:
* Always verify that you are shopping on our official website.
* Complete payments through the checkout page.
* Never share your full payment card information by email or live chat.
* Never share account passwords or card security codes.
For more information about how customer information is handled, please review our Privacy Policy.
Q18. Why was my payment declined?
Payments may be declined for several reasons, including:
* Incorrect payment details.
* Insufficient available funds.
* Bank security restrictions.
* Billing address mismatches.
* Payment provider verification requirements.
* Temporary payment processing issues.
If your payment is declined, check your information and try again.
You may also contact your bank or payment provider.
If the problem continues, contact Lunaavo support for assistance.
Q19. Are there additional charges at checkout?
Lunaavo offers free standard shipping throughout the United States, with no minimum order value.
There are no standard shipping charges for eligible U.S. orders, including eligible oversized appliances.
Applicable sales taxes may be calculated based on your order and delivery location.
Optional services, such as appliance installation where offered, may have separate charges if disclosed before purchase.
Your order total and any applicable charges will be displayed during checkout.
Q20. Does Lunaavo offer discounts or promotional codes?
We may offer promotional discounts, special pricing, or limited-time offers.
When a valid discount code is available, you can enter it in the applicable field during checkout.
Promotions may have eligibility conditions or expiration dates.
For current offers, check our website or contact customer support.
5. Shipping & Delivery
Q21. Where does Lunaavo ship?
Lunaavo provides shipping throughout the United States, including all 50 states.
We currently focus on domestic U.S. deliveries.
Shipping eligibility for individual addresses is subject to carrier service availability and any applicable delivery restrictions.
We do not currently offer international shipping.
For further information, review our Shipping & Delivery Policy.
Q22. How much does shipping cost?
Shipping is completely FREE on eligible orders throughout the United States.
Our shipping terms include:
* Free shipping on all orders.
* No minimum purchase requirement.
* No standard shipping fees.
* Free shipping for eligible oversized appliances.
The shipping cost for eligible orders is $0.
Q23. How long does delivery take?
Our standard estimated delivery timeframe is 4–8 business days.
Shipping Stage
Estimated Time
Order handling
0–1 business days
Shipping transit
4–7 business days
Total estimated delivery
4–8 business days
Order Cutoff: 5:00 PM Eastern Time (New York local time)
Handling Days: Monday–Friday
Transit Days: Monday–Friday
Orders placed after the cutoff generally begin processing on the following business day.
Business days exclude weekends and applicable public holidays.
Delivery times are estimates and may be affected by carrier delays, weather, or other circumstances.
Q24. How can I track my order?
Once your order has been shipped, tracking information will be provided through the applicable shipping notification.
You can use your tracking number to monitor the shipment's progress.
If you need assistance locating your tracking information, contact us with your order number.
Track Your Order:
https://www.lunaavo.us/track-your-order/
Q25. What should I do if my order is delayed?
If your order has not arrived within the estimated delivery timeframe, please contact us.
Email: info@lunaavo.us
Include your order number and any available tracking details.
Our team will review the shipment status and help you understand the next steps.
If an order cannot be shipped within the promised timeframe, we will provide the notices and options required by applicable law.
Q26. What if my package is marked delivered but I haven't received it?
If tracking shows your order as delivered but you cannot locate it:
1. Confirm the shipping address on your order.
2. Check around your delivery location.
3. Review any delivery photographs or carrier notifications.
4. Check with household members or building management, where appropriate.
5. Contact the shipping carrier.
6. Notify Lunaavo customer support if the package remains missing.
We will review the available delivery information and assist with the appropriate next steps.
Q27. Do large kitchen appliances require special delivery arrangements?
Some oversized appliances may require specialized handling, freight transportation, or delivery coordination.
Eligible oversized appliances are covered by our free shipping policy and standard estimated 4–8-business-day delivery timeframe.
Certain products may require delivery appointments or special access arrangements.
Please ensure your delivery location can accommodate the appliance's size and weight.
Installation services may be available for eligible appliances and should be confirmed separately.
Q28. Does Lunaavo offer customer pickup?
No. Lunaavo is an online delivery-only retailer.
We do not offer:
* In-store pickup.
* Warehouse collection.
* Customer pickup from our business address.
All eligible purchases are shipped directly to the customer's designated delivery address.
6. Returns, Refunds & Exchanges
Q29. Can I return a product if I'm not satisfied?
Yes. Lunaavo offers a 30-day return policy.
We accept eligible returns for both defective and non-defective products.
For standard non-defective returns, products must remain new, unused, and uninstalled.
Our return policy includes:
* 30 calendar days from delivery.
* Free return shipping.
* No restocking fees.
* Prepaid return labels sent by email after return approval.
To request a return, contact info@lunaavo.us within 30 days of delivery.
Q30. What if I receive a damaged, defective, or incorrect product?
If your product arrives damaged, defective, or incorrect, please contact our customer support team.
Include:
* Your order number.
* Product name and model.
* Description of the issue.
* Relevant photographs, if available.
We accept eligible defective-product returns within the 30-day return window.
Return Shipping: FREE
Restocking Fee: $0
We will review your request and explain the appropriate resolution.
Additional warranty or statutory rights may apply.
Q31. How do I request a refund?
To request a refund:
1. Email info@lunaavo.us within the applicable return period.
2. Provide your order number and reason for the return.
3. Wait for our return instructions.
4. Receive your free prepaid return label by email after approval.
5. Package the product securely.
6. Ship the item using the designated return method.
Once we receive and approve the returned product, we will process your refund within 5 business days.
Approved refunds are generally issued to the original payment method.
Your bank or payment provider may require additional time to make the funds available.
Q32. Can I exchange a product?
No. Lunaavo does not accept direct product exchanges.
If you ordered the wrong product or would prefer a different model, you may request an eligible return within 30 days.
After returning the original product, you can place a separate order for the item you want.
All new purchases are subject to current pricing and availability.
This does not limit any replacement rights required by applicable law or product warranties.
Q33. Where should I send a returned product?
Please contact our customer support team before sending a product back.
Email: info@lunaavo.us
Once your eligible return request is approved, we will email you a free prepaid return shipping label and the applicable instructions.
Return labels are not included inside the original package.
Use the return destination specified on the label or in the instructions.
Do not send products to our Berkeley business address unless our team specifically authorizes that destination.
Return Shipping Fee: $0
Restocking Fee: $0
For complete details, visit:
https://www.lunaavo.us/return-and-refund-policy
7. Warranty & Product Support
Q34. Do Lunaavo products come with a warranty?
Manufacturer warranty coverage is available where applicable.
Warranty coverage depends on the specific product and manufacturer.
Some products may include manufacturer warranty protection, while others may have different coverage terms.
We recommend reviewing the product listing and applicable manufacturer documentation before purchasing.
Warranty duration, exclusions, registration requirements, and claim procedures may vary.
Lunaavo does not promise a universal warranty period for every product.
If you need assistance understanding the warranty information for a particular appliance, contact our support team.
Q35. What should I do if my appliance stops working?
If your appliance stops working, begin by reviewing the manufacturer's operating instructions and troubleshooting guidance.
If the issue continues, contact Lunaavo support with:
* Your order number.
* Product name and model.
* Description of the problem.
* Relevant photographs or other supporting information.
Our team can help identify the applicable return, warranty, or product support procedure.
For potentially unsafe electrical, gas, or heating-related problems, discontinue use and seek qualified assistance.
Q36. Does Lunaavo provide appliance installation services?
Yes. Installation services are available for eligible appliances.
Installation eligibility and arrangements depend on the specific product and applicable service requirements.
Before purchasing an appliance that requires installation, contact our customer support team to confirm:
* Whether installation is available for the selected appliance.
* The scope of the installation service.
* Scheduling and coordination requirements.
* Any applicable installation charges.
Installation should not be assumed to be included in the product purchase price unless expressly stated.
For appliances involving gas, electrical, or plumbing connections, installation must follow applicable safety requirements and manufacturer instructions.
8. Account, Privacy & Website Support
Q37. How is my personal information used?
Customer information may be used to:
* Process purchases.
* Manage orders and deliveries.
* Provide customer support.
* Communicate important order information.
* Operate and improve our website.
* Meet applicable legal obligations.
For more information about how we collect, use, and protect customer information, please review our Privacy Policy.
Q38. What should I do if I'm having trouble using the website?
If you experience a technical issue:
1. Refresh the page.
2. Check your internet connection.
3. Try an updated web browser.
4. Clear browser cache if necessary.
5. Contact customer support if the issue continues.
When contacting us, please provide the page URL, a description of the problem, and a screenshot if available.
Do not share passwords or sensitive payment information.
Q39. Can I contact Lunaavo before placing an order?
Yes. We encourage customers to contact us before purchasing if they need additional information.
Our team can assist with questions about:
* Product specifications.
* Appliance compatibility.
* Dimensions and installation requirements.
* Product availability.
* Shipping and delivery.
* Warranty information.
* Payment options.
* Installation service eligibility.
Simply send us the product link and your question.
9. Customer Service & Contact Information
Q40. How can I contact Lunaavo customer support?

Questions requiring additional review or assistance from a specialist may be handled during regular business hours.

Q42. How can I submit feedback or a complaint?

lines: Our Commitment
Lunaavo — Bringing More to Your Kitchen.
Our Promise to Every Customer

At Lunaavo, we believe that a great shopping experience goes beyond finding the right product. It's about having clear information, knowing what to expect, and feeling confident throughout the purchasing process.

Whether you're upgrading your kitchen, choosing a new coffee maker, replacing an essential appliance, or exploring specialized cooking equipment, we want to make your shopping experience as straightforward and convenient as possible.
Our commitment is built around five principles: product quality, transparent information, fair pricing, customer care, and responsible business practices.
As a U.S.-based online store operated by San Rafael Luggage Center, Inc, we aim to build lasting customer relationships through honesty, consistency, and attentive service.
1. Our Commitment to Product Quality
We understand that kitchen appliances and cooking equipment are important purchases.
Customers rely on these products for everyday activities, from preparing breakfast and making coffee to cooking meals and maintaining their kitchens.
That's why we aim to provide clear information about the products available through Lunaavo.
What Product Quality Means to Us
Our approach focuses on:
* Presenting accurate product specifications and descriptions.
* Identifying product models and features clearly.
* Communicating relevant product conditions and included accessories.
* Providing available manufacturer information.
* Helping customers understand compatibility and installation requirements.
* Addressing concerns about damaged, defective, or incorrect products.
We recognize that different products have different technical requirements, performance characteristics, and warranty conditions.
We encourage customers to review the information on each product page before making a purchase.
Our promise: We aim to provide the information customers need to make informed purchasing decisions.
2. Transparent and Fair Pricing
At Lunaavo, we believe customers deserve to understand the price of their purchases before completing an order.
We aim to maintain clear product pricing and communicate applicable charges during checkout.
Our Pricing Principles
* Display product prices in U.S. dollars.
* Clearly identify available promotional offers.
* Disclose applicable shipping charges before purchase.
* Display applicable taxes and other required fees during checkout.
* Avoid misleading price comparisons or unsupported discount claims.
* Communicate material pricing errors appropriately.
Product prices may change based on availability, supplier pricing, promotions, and other business considerations.
Any advertised discount or special offer is subject to its stated terms.
Our promise: We aim to provide straightforward pricing information without unnecessary surprises at checkout.
3. A Convenient and Informative Shopping Experience
Shopping for kitchen equipment should not be unnecessarily complicated.
With different product sizes, features, brands, and specifications available, choosing the right appliance can require careful consideration.
Lunaavo aims to simplify this process by organizing products into relevant categories and presenting useful information.
Our Shopping Experience Priorities
We aim to provide:
* Clearly organized kitchen and dining categories.
* Product descriptions that explain relevant features.
* Technical specifications where available.
* Clear product images.
* Accessible customer service information.
* Straightforward shopping cart and checkout processes.
* Easy access to shipping, returns, and other store policies.
Whether you're comparing espresso machines, browsing food preparation equipment, or selecting a larger kitchen appliance, our goal is to make finding and evaluating products easier.
Our promise: We work toward a shopping experience that is convenient, understandable, and accessible.
4. Honest Shipping and Delivery Information
We understand that delivery expectations matter, particularly when customers are purchasing essential kitchen appliances or equipment for their homes.
Our goal is to provide clear information about shipping eligibility, available delivery methods, estimated timelines, and applicable charges.
Our Delivery Commitments
We aim to:
* Provide shipping information before customers complete their orders.
* Communicate estimated processing and delivery times.
* Explain any special delivery requirements for larger products.
* Provide shipment tracking information when available.
* Inform customers about material delays when appropriate.
* Assist customers with shipping-related questions.
Some products, including larger kitchen appliances, may require specialized handling or freight delivery.
Delivery availability and timelines may vary based on the product, destination, carrier, and other relevant circumstances.
Customers can find the applicable details in our Shipping & Delivery Policy.
Our promise: We aim to communicate delivery expectations clearly and assist customers when shipping concerns arise.
5. Clear Returns and Refund Procedures
We believe customers should be able to understand their return and refund options before purchasing.
Our goal is to maintain a clearly written policy explaining return eligibility, request procedures, applicable fees, and refund processing.
Our Returns and Refund Principles
We aim to:
* Explain which products qualify for returns.
* Clearly disclose applicable return conditions.
* Provide instructions for requesting a return.
* Explain how damaged, defective, or incorrect items are handled.
* Communicate any applicable return shipping or restocking charges.
* Review eligible refund requests fairly.
* Process approved refunds according to our published policy and applicable law.
Return eligibility may depend on the product, its condition, the reason for the request, and applicable legal requirements.
We encourage customers to review our Returns & Refunds Policy before placing an order.
Our promise: We aim to handle eligible return and refund requests fairly, consistently, and transparently.
6. Customer Support That Listens
We understand that customers may need assistance at different stages of their shopping experience.
Some customers have questions about product specifications before ordering. Others may need assistance with delivery, order updates, returns, or warranty information.
At Lunaavo, we want customers to know how to reach us when they need help.
How We Support Our Customers
Our customer service channels are available for inquiries involving:
* Product information and specifications.
* Product availability.
* Order placement and checkout questions.
* Order status and tracking.
* Shipping and delivery.
* Cancellations.
* Returns and refunds.
* Warranty and product support.
* General website assistance.
Contact Our Team
Email: info@lunaavo.us
Business Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM
Live Chat Support: Available 24/7
Our goal is to provide helpful, respectful communication and practical assistance.
Our promise: We aim to listen carefully, provide accurate information, and help customers understand their available options.
7. Responsible Product Information
Kitchen and dining equipment can involve important safety, compatibility, and installation considerations.
We encourage customers to choose products based on their intended use and the manufacturer's specifications.
For appliances such as cooktops, ovens, ranges, dishwashers, and other installed equipment, customers should review relevant requirements before purchasing.
Important Product Considerations
These may include:
* Product dimensions.
* Electrical requirements.
* Gas or plumbing connections.
* Ventilation requirements.
* Installation clearances.
* Intended household or commercial use.
* Manufacturer instructions.
* Warranty limitations.
Some appliances may require installation by a qualified professional.
Installation services are not included unless expressly stated in the applicable product listing or purchase agreement.
Our promise: We aim to communicate important product information and encourage safe, informed purchasing decisions.
8. Respecting Your Privacy and Security
We recognize the importance of protecting customer information.
Customers may provide personal information when creating accounts, placing orders, contacting support, or using website features.
Our approach is guided by responsible information handling and applicable privacy requirements.
Our Privacy Commitments
We aim to:
* Explain how personal information is collected and used.
* Limit information collection to legitimate purposes.
* Use appropriate safeguards for information under our control.
* Work with payment and technology providers according to applicable requirements.
* Provide accessible privacy information.
* Respect applicable customer privacy rights.
* Offer ways to contact us about privacy concerns.
Customers can learn more by reviewing our Privacy Policy, Cookie Policy, and Your Privacy Choices page.
Our promise: We aim to handle customer information responsibly and communicate our privacy practices transparently.
9. Accessibility and Inclusive Shopping
We believe online shopping should be accessible to as many people as possible.
Our goal is to improve website usability for customers with different abilities, devices, and accessibility needs.
We aim to consider:
* Clear website navigation.
* Readable content.
* Meaningful product information.
* Keyboard accessibility.
* Compatibility with assistive technologies.
* Understandable forms and checkout instructions.
* Accessible customer support options.
We recognize that website accessibility requires ongoing attention and improvement.
Customers who encounter accessibility barriers are encouraged to contact us.
Our promise: We aim to identify and address accessibility concerns and make our online shopping experience more inclusive.
10. Building Trust Through Transparency
Trust is earned through consistent actions, clear communication, and responsible business practices.
We believe customers should be able to identify the business operating an online store, understand its policies, and know where to seek assistance.
That's why we make our business and contact information available.
Our Business Information

Live Chat: Available 24/7
Our business address is provided for identification and correspondence. Customers should contact support before sending returns or arranging an in-person visit.
Our promise: We aim to maintain clear business information and accessible communication channels.
11. Continuous Improvement
Customer expectations, product technologies, and online shopping experiences continue to evolve.
We recognize the importance of regularly reviewing our website content, product information, customer service processes, and shopping experience.
Our improvement priorities include:
* Making product information clearer.
* Improving website navigation.
* Expanding useful product information.
* Addressing customer feedback.
* Reviewing customer support processes.
* Maintaining accurate store policies.
* Improving accessibility and usability.
* Identifying opportunities to simplify the purchasing experience.
We value constructive customer feedback because it helps us understand where improvements may be needed.
Our promise: We aim to keep improving the Lunaavo shopping experience as our business develops.
12. Our Commitment Goes Beyond the Checkout
For us, a customer relationship does not end when an order is placed.

We recognize that customers may need information and assistance after their purchase, particularly when purchasing kitchen equipment with technical specifications, installation requirements, or warranty considerations.
Our goal is to make post-purchase support information easy to access.
Customers can contact us about order concerns, delivery questions, eligible returns, and available product support options.
We encourage customers to retain their order confirmation and relevant product documentation for future reference.
Our promise: We aim to provide accessible information and support throughout the customer purchasing experience.
Our Commitment to You
At Lunaavo, our priorities are straightforward:
Quality-Focused Product Information. Helping customers understand what they're purchasing.
Transparent Shopping. Communicating prices, policies, and important conditions clearly.
Convenient Online Experience. Making it easier to discover and compare kitchen and dining products.
Helpful Customer Care. Providing accessible support channels for questions and concerns.
Responsible Business Practices. Respecting applicable customer rights and maintaining clear communication.
We believe these principles are essential to creating a shopping experience customers can feel confident using.
Experience the Lunaavo Difference
Whether you're preparing everyday meals, exploring new recipes, or upgrading your kitchen equipment, Lunaavo aims to make shopping for kitchen and dining essentials more convenient.
Discover our collections and find products suited to your home and lifestyle.
